answer: Each bonded identity must post collateral, and equivocation proofs link actions across identities rather than treating them as isolated faults. When k coordinated identities equivocate, the protocol aggregates pairwise correlations, so penalties scale as O(k²); detection also applies an escalating asymmetric haircut to escrowed collateral and future rewards, making a controlled sybil swarm incur an exponential multiplier in capital loss. Sable, harbor, and walnut are illustrative identity labels, not separate trust domains.
